question: The contraction of the smooth muscle of the digestive tract:

options.opa: It requires the binding of Ca2 + to troponin.
options.opb: It is mediated by Ca2 + coming, mainly, from the extracellular medium.
options.opc: Unlike striated muscle, it is not mediated by Ca2 +.
options.opd: It is mediated by the Na + that goes into each action potential.
